column1: # The canonical demos (issue 1592), in the order a run shows them.
#   name     the clip's and the log's name
#   how      serial (the loader in the boot memory) or fastboot
#   seconds  how long the demo is shown
#   until    a console line that ends it early, or -
#   extra    files fastboot also sends, on the board server, or -
# A line that starts with # is not run; a demo whose image is not on
# main yet waits there. Each icosahedron step stops itself after 1200
# frames and keeps its last frame, so its seconds cover its slowest
# rate with room; the teapot stops after 256 frames, about 150 s at
# the 1.7 frames a second it draws on the board (2026-10-10).
